description: This PHP source file defines the class 'AssumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider', which provides credentials by assuming an IAM role with a web identity on AWS. It includes methods for configuration, token file handling, and credential retrieval via AWS STS.

classes.name: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider
classes.description: Class responsible for obtaining AWS credentials by assuming a role with a web identity token, primarily used for federated identity authentication.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with configuration options, including role ARN, token file, session info, and AWS client setup. Loads environment variables if available.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves credentials by assuming the specified role with the web identity token, handling retries and errors.
